senses.gloss: m. (כלב; v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; cmp. כְּלוּב, כְּלִיבָה; Var. lect. אַכְלְכָא, v. infra) shed, store-room.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 63b:4">B. Mets. 63ᵇ</cite> <he>חיטי … באַכְלְבָאִי</he> (v. Var. lect. in Rabb. D. S. a. l.; Mss. a. Ar. <he>אכלכא</he>) would my wheat have gone to ruin in my granary? <cite ref="Taanit 24a:9">Taan. 24ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).—Pl. <he>אַכְלְבֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Gittin 56a:9">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>אכלבא … שתין א׳ וכ׳</he> one shed of wheat requires sixty sheds of wood (for baking).
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72b:11">B. Mets. 72ᵇ</cite> <he>חיטי דא׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>באכלכי</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) wheat stored in granaries &c.
